To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) NLP is an important tool in the accounting, auditing and corporate finance literature; (ii) it is used in a wide variety of applications, including text analysis, text generation, and text summarization; (iii) NLP applications have a wide variety of benefits, including improved understanding, better decision making, and improved efficiency; (iv) there are a wide variety of NLP applications in accounting, auditing, and corporate finance, but the majority of applications focus on text analysis

NLP applications are being used to mine textual data from a variety of accounting, auditing, and finance sources to obtain insights and to create additional artefacts to advance accounting, auditing and financial knowledge and practice.

NLP is a powerful tool for extracting knowledge from the large volumes of textual documents that are generated in accounting, auditing, and finance, but that it is still in its infancy.
